2.
In the given case scenario, if the tolerable misstatement is increased to
` 2,00,000 how will it affect the audit sample size?
(A)  Sample size will increase.
(B)  Sample size will decrease.
(C)  Sample size will remain unchanged.
(D)  No relationship exists between the two.
(2 Marks)
